patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Adapt.io and ZoomInfo share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Adapt.io only if your buying job matches “Regional B2B contact database with credit plans — Free; Starter $49/mo; Basic $99/mo; Cust” rather than ZoomInfo's shape. Choose ZoomInfo only if your buying job matches “Enterprise go-to-market intelligence platform for B2B contact/company data, enrichment, in” rather than Adapt.io's shape. Workflow advantage: Adapt.io leans contact-management; ZoomInfo leans lead-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Adapt.io and ZoomInfo share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Adapt.io is Regional B2B contact database with credit plans — Free; Starter $49/mo; Basic $99/mo; Custom contact sales; 7-day trial.; ZoomInfo is Enterprise go-to-market intelligence platform for B2B contact/company data, enrichment, intent, and Copilot workflows — custom-quote packagi.
- Company-size focus: Adapt.io (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs ZoomInfo (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Adapt.io-leaning contact-management vs ZoomInfo-leaning lead-management.
- Researched limits: Adapt.io — Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches; ZoomInfo — Main platform seat prices are not published — packaging is custom quote.

Limitations — Adapt.io: Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches; No native email sequencing — data/export first; ZoomInfo: Main platform seat prices are not published — packaging is custom quote; Credit consumption on export (CSV/CRM/API) requires ongoing governance.

Poor-fit cases: Adapt.io is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches · ZoomInfo is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Main platform seat prices are not published — packaging is custom quote · Avoid Adapt.io if you actually need ZoomInfo's motion (Enterprise go-to-market intelligence platform for B2B contact/company data, enri)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
